title: Cortical hierarchies are folded variational autoencoders

statements.text: Cortical hierarchies are analogous to variational autoencoders folded at their low-dimensional bottlenecks, with superficial pyramidal neurons as encoders whose inputs are explained away by predictions from deep pyramidal neurons and thalamic relays, so that only prediction errors pass upward.

sources.quote: viewing cortical hierarchies as analogous to VAEs [32, 33], where encoding and generative decoding networks have been folded over at their reduceddimensionality bottlenecks
